programme.title: Barbara Hannigan & Cleveland Orchestra
programme.desc: Barbara Hannigan, soprano and conductor, won the Grammy for “Best Classical Solo Vocal Album CRAZY GIRL CRAZY (Gershwin, Berg and Berio) 2018 and took home the Grammy for “Artist of the Year” in 2022. In autumn 2023 she made her long-awaited conducting debut with the Cleveland Orchestra. The programme featured an interesting mix of old and new with Haydn´s Symphony No. 44 in E-minor, Vivier´s Lonely Child', Ligeti´s 'Lontano' and Death and Transfiguration by Richard Strauss.

programme.title: Foreigner
programme.desc: Featuring the classic Foreigner line-up of Jones, Gramm, McDonald, Greenwood, Gagliardi and Elliott, this show captures the essence of a group who would go on to become one of the best-selling bands of all time. On April 27 1978, after their self-titled debut album had spent a year in the US Top 20, rock's conquering heroes played a sold-out show at London's legendary music venue, the Rainbow Theatre. Opening with 'Long, Long Way From Home', the band's legion of fans were treated to a magnificent display of musicianship and performance, including local hit singles, 'Feels Like The First Time' and 'Cold As Ice', as well as an exclusive preview of two tracks from the upcoming ‘Double Vision' album. Forty years on, this definitive performance by the original band has been restored from the original film reels, remixed and remastered for this release.

programme.title: John Mellencamp
programme.desc: John Mellencamp's career in music, spanning more than 42 years, has seen him transition from pop star to one of the most highly regarded songwriters of a generation. Filmed at the landmark Chicago Theatre, just 250 miles away from his upbringing in Indiana, this cinematic concert documentary film captures John Mellencamp reflecting on his career accompanied by self-narration from his highly personal audio diary on his Midwestern upbringing, career and outlook on life as a whole. Meant to be more than just your run of the mill concert film, this intimate performance with full band will fully envelop the viewer into the Mellencamp mindset. “My vision was true, and my heart was too. And there was no end to what I could dream. Life is short, even in its longest days.”

programme.title: Lady Gaga
programme.desc: Lady Gaga's performance at the iTunes Festival in London on September 1, 2013 marks the superstar's first full concert since the The Born This Way Ball. It is an eight song set containing the world premiere of seven tracks from her fourth album, ARTPOP: "Aura" "MANiCURE" "Artpop" "Jewels N' Drugs" ft. T.I., Too $hort and Twista "Sexxx Dreams", "Swine" and "I Wanna Be With You", a song that transformed into "Dope" for ARTPOP. During the concert, captured stunningly in HD, Gaga says that she's "a bit like Dorothy right now." The stage is her Kansas, the crowd is her family, and their reunion is pure magic. Lady Gaga, her dancers, and her band traverse through visual and musical themes of love, sex, violence, beauty, danger, empowerment, hustle, lust, and above all ART. Throughout, Gaga lays her heart bare for the audience and the cameras with every note sung and every word spoken.

programme.desc: Alice Howland, happily married with three grown children, is a renowned linguistics professor who starts to forget words. When she receives a devastating diagnosis, Alice and her family find their bonds tested.

programme.title: Mary and The Witch's Flower
programme.desc: Young Mary follows a mysterious cat into the nearby forest and discovers an old broomstick and the strange Fly-by-Night flower, a rare plant that blossoms once every seven years. Together, the flower and the broomstick whisk Mary above the clouds, and far away to Endor College, a school of magic...

programme.title: Lars and the real girl
programme.desc: Extremely shy Lars strikes up an unconventional relationship with a doll he finds on the Internet. On the advice of a doctor, his family and neighbours go along with his delusion.

programme.title: Attack of the Lederhosen Zombies
programme.desc: Zombie action in the Alps: a group of young snowboarder is stuck in a remote mountain ski resort, where an all-night aprés-ski party soon turns into a hellish nightmare of zombie mayhem.

programme.title: Gorgo
programme.desc: The classic sci-fi story of a captured baby prehistoric monster put on display in London, with giant momma monster coming to the rescue!

programme.title: Love's Second Chance
programme.desc: Passionate fashion stylist Rose is in her 30s and living in New York. When she inherits her grandmother's vintage dress shop, she returns to her small hometown to take care of the store and bumps into her high school crush Cole.

programme.title: Love at Sunset Terrace
programme.desc: Tired of her fast-paced life in the city, Sophie Carter travels to a small seaside town to disconnect and self-reflect, staying at an Airbnb run by a widowed father of a young girl. With a little nudging from the matchmaking daughter, Sophie and Michael unexpectedly start to fall in love and Sophie must decide between returning home or following her heart.

programme.title: A Handful of Dust
programme.desc: The wife's affair and a death in the family hasten the demise of an upper-class English marriage.

programme.title: Match Point
programme.desc: At a turning point in his life, a former tennis pro falls for an actress who happens to be dating his friend and soon-to-be brother-in-law.

programme.title: My All American
programme.desc: Freddie Steinmark, an underdog on the gridiron, faces the toughest challenge of his life after leading his team to a championship season.

programme.title: Made In America
programme.desc: When Zora Mathews goes searching for her biological, anonymous sperm donor father, she and her Afro-centric mother Sarah are dumbfounded to discover Hal Jackson, an obnoxious used car salesman on late-night TV and worse than that, he's white.

programme.title: In Time
programme.desc: Justin Timberlake and Amanda Seyfried co-star in this sci-fi thriller set in a future world where aging stops at 25, and the only way for one man to stay alive is to steal more time.

programme.title: The Divergent Series: Insurgent
programme.desc: Tris must confront her inner demons and fight against an alliance which threatens to tear her society apart.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: When Traci is a no-show for her first raid, 15 Division fears the gun dealer they're after has kidnapped her.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: After a baseball game erupts in a drive-by shooting, Gail and her brother search for the shooter.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Andy and Sam are shocked to learn that Oliver is the prime suspect in IA's corruption investigation.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Andy, Dov, Gail, and Nick undertake a risky plan to prove that Commissioner Alonso Santana is corrupt.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: A heat wave hits and Jarvis opens the division to the public as a cooling station.

programme.title: The Nutcracker Sweet
programme.desc: It is Christmas Eve and the Silberhaus children are excited for the festivities to begin. Marie and Fritz are playing in the children's room when their godfather Drosselmayer arrives and presents them with an early Christmas gift, a Nutcracker. Marie witnesses a great battle between a vast army of toy soldiers led by the Nutcracker against a terrible platoon of mice commanded by the Mouse King. Follow Marie and Fritz's journey in the Kingdom of Dolls, through the Christmas Forest, past the Almond Milk Sea, and the Palace of the Marzipans.

programme.title: Tangerine
programme.desc: It's Christmas Eve in Tinseltown and Sin-Dee (Kitana Kiki Rodriguez) is back on the block. Upon hearing that her pimp boyfriend (James Ransone) hasn't been faithful during the 28 days she was locked up, the working girl and her best friend, Alexandra (Mya Taylor), embark on a mission to get to the bottom of the scandalous rumour. Their rip-roaring odyssey leads them through various subcultures of Los Angeles, including an Armenian family dealing with their own repercussions of infidelity.

programme.title: Santa Stole Our Dog
programme.desc: A magical holiday adventure featuring original Christmas songs by Dolly Parton, and starring Golden Globe winner, Ed Asner (Elf, Up). The Whitehaven family embark on a whirlwind adventure to the North Pole when their beloved dog, Rusty, goes missing on Christmas Eve.

programme.title: 12 Dogs of Christmas 2: Great Puppy Rescue
programme.desc: In this heartwarming sequel to the holiday classic, Emma (Danielle Chuchran) rallies her friends new and old to save a beloved puppy orphanage by putting on a musical holiday extravaganza.

programme.title: Feather Christmas
programme.desc: For single dad, and veterinarian, Martin, Christmas is all about upholding regular family traditions to keep the memory of his late wife alive. But when an ailing pet chicken arrives at his home-run animal sanctuary, the family's festive plans, and entire world, are turned upside down, as new love blossoms and spreads its wings!

programme.title: Open 24 Hours
programme.desc: After surviving and killing her serial killer boyfriend, a young woman rebuilds her life with a new job at an all-night gas station. Haunted by visions of her boyfriend's crimes and delusions of his imminent return, what seems like a routine night becomes one of mayhem and murder. As the bodies start to pile up, will she survive the night?

programme.title: Evidence
programme.desc: A terrifying take on found-footage-horror, this chilling film revolves around a team of detectives (Stephen Moyer: True Blood and Radha Mitchell: London has Fallen), who attempt to piece together what happened at the scene of a brutal massacre, using a number of recording devices found at the crime scene. Prepare yourself for a petrifying and spine-tingling nightmare with a chilling turn.

programme.title: Arthur & Merlin: The Knights of Camelot
programme.desc: Starring Game of Thrones legend, Richard Brake. 463 AD, England. King Arthur has been absent for five long years, fighting a war that has stricken his knights, left his throne defenceless and his queen at the mercy of Modred. But as he fights to preserve Camelot - the toughest conflict is within himself. Guided by wizard Merlin, Arthur must strive to become the king that his nation needs.

programme.title: Mythica: The Dragon Slayer
programme.desc: The end is here. Join sorceress Marek in the spectacular and gripping finale of the legendary Mythica journey. With a new evil to defeat, Marek embarks on an arduous quest to gain a valuable weapon from the Gods. From battling the Lich King's evil zombie legions to joining forces with her sworn enemy, will Marek save the Gods, the world and herself in time?

programme.title: Sweetland
programme.desc: Sweetland is the story of an isolated community at the outermost edge of the world, and the struggles of one man determined to resist its extinction.

programme.title: Escape from Germany
programme.desc: In 1939, 85 American missionaries made a daring escape from Nazi Germany as Hitler closed borders in one of church history's most dramatic moments.

programme.title: The Vow
programme.desc: Real-life story of a newlywed New Mexico couple, Kim and Krickitt Carpenter, who were struck by tragedy shortly after their marriage. A car crash puts the wife in a coma, where she is cared for by her devoted husband.

programme.title: Hope Gap
programme.desc: Annette Bening, Bill Nighy and Josh O'Connor shine in William Nicholson's intimate portrait of a family crisis.

programme.title: Once Upon a Christmas Miracle
programme.desc: (2018) Festive romance starring Aimee Teegarden. A life-saving transplant brings two strangers together - and as the holidays approach, a heartfelt connection turns into something more.

programme.title: Christmas in the Air
programme.desc: Robert, a widower and father of two children, enlists Lydia to help him juggle his chaotic work-life balance at Christmastime. Will their close relationship lead to love? Stars Catherine Bell. (2017)

programme.title: Candy Cane Christmas
programme.desc: (2020) Christmas romance with Beverley Mitchell. When her favourite tradition of decorating Candy Cane Lane is cancelled, can Phoebe find something - or someone - new to lift her Christmas spirits?

programme.title: My Sweet Holiday
programme.desc: (2020) Festive romance starring Malone Thomas. When Sadie agrees to train the charming new owner of her family's chocolate shop, she gets more than a taste of holiday love.

programme.title: Heartbreakers
programme.desc: Max and Page are a mother and daughter con team with a devious routine. Max targets wealthy men, lures them into marriage and then Page seduces them, leaving Max to discover their infidelity and reap the huge divorce settlements which tide them over until they target their next victim.

programme.title: About Fate
programme.desc: When both of their engagement proposals are a bust, hopeless romantics Margot (Emma Roberts) and Griffin (Thomas Mann) find themselves together on New Year's Eve after a bout of fateful events.

programme.title: Listen Out for Love
programme.desc: Peyton Pepper, a goal-driven podcast producer, is forced to mold Alex McKinney, a brash loose cannon, into her next star and create the perfect show to save both of their careers. That show comes in the form of finding Peyton's iconic idol, true love.

programme.title: Made for You, with Love
programme.desc: The owner of a second hand wedding dress business breathes new life into used dresses, making dreams come true for brides unable to afford pricey gowns. But when she meets the perfect guy, she's afraid to give her own heart a second chance at love.

programme.title: Hint of Love
programme.desc: A cookbook literary agent with culinary training is tasked with helping elevate the brand of a food channel personality known for his convenience-oriented recipes. However, as the agent works with her client on a new cookbook, she must choose between following the directions or her heart.

programme.title: Christmas For Three
programme.desc: When a successful bachelor suddenly finds himself as the guardian of a 10 year old boy, he leans on the smart and beautiful social worker for help, only to fall in love with the woman who turned his life upside down.

programme.title: Frankie and Johnny
programme.desc: Join Elvis Presley and Donna Douglas for a riverboat ride of rollicking musical entertainment in this charming and sassy comic hit about a gambler and his lady love.

programme.title: Love Wedding Marriage
programme.desc: A happy newlywed marriage counselor's views on wedded bliss get thrown for a loop when she finds out her parents are getting divorced. Starring: Mandy Moore, Kellan Lutz, James Brolin

programme.title: 2 Years of Love
programme.desc: Samantha has a great marriage, until the pressure to have a baby comes up. Things get tricky when she starts falling for one of her clients, not realizing it is secretly her husband. Will they be able to make it through this rough patch?

programme.title: Farm To Fork To Love
programme.desc: A young and talented chef, ALICE (Meggan Kaiser), works as a sous chef at one of the top restaurants in New York. After a disastrous night serving a food critic, she receives an invitation to judge a food competition in honor of the prestigious annual fundraiser for the St. Andrew's Children's Hospital. Alice accepts the invitation despite the dismay of BRETT, her boss who is also her boyfriend. Once she gets to Kansas, Alice is surprised to find her former boyfriend in college, CHRISTIAN (Scot cooper), is amongst the judges. The cooking show and her reconnection with Christian will make Alice reconsider her calling and make her dreams come true.

programme.title: A Taste of Tuscany
programme.desc: April is a health chef guru who goes to Italy to learn how to incorporate the country's rich culture of food in her own recipes. April finds new joy and freedom in life and cooking – and also love.

programme.title: A Gift For Christmas
programme.desc: A handsome stranger develops amnesia after a bibliophile crashes into him on her bicycle.

programme.title: Love Finds You In Valentine
programme.desc: What can a California girl do with a few dusty acres of land in rural Nebraska? So Kennedy Blaine wonders after she inherits a ranch in the small town of Valentine, Nebraska. As Kennedy makes arrangements to sell the property, she finds herself drawn to the ranch and to its attractive manager, Derek Sterling. She decides to spend the summer in her ancestral home and reconnect with family members. But soon Kennedy is subjected to harassment by someone who clearly wants her to leave Valentine. Depending on God's protection and Derek's assistance, she sets out to discover who is behind the offenses. But when her search reveals painful details about her family and raises questions about Derek's own past, will Kennedy still want to know the truth?

programme.title: Love Switch
programme.desc: On their 13th wedding anniversary, James and Michelle wake up to discover they have somehow switched bodies. Unable to switch back, they are forced to understand what the other goes through daily.

programme.title: A Gift Wrapped Christmas
programme.desc: Personal shopper Gwen's new client Charlie is a workaholic, single father. Charlie

programme.title: My Christmas Grandpa.
programme.desc: Girl requests cashier as grandpa for Christmas Vivica A. Fox, Bill Cobbs star.

programme.title: Murder at the Mansion
programme.desc: As her wedding day approaches, a woman uncovers some deadly secrets hidden at her fiancé's lush family estate.

programme.title: God's Club
programme.desc: A debate about allowing school prayer pits Christians against Atheist.

programme.title: WWJD II The Woodcarver
programme.desc: A troubled youth vandalizes a church and winds up in a close association with the woodcarver whose work he destroyed.

programme.title: Wish You Were Dead
programme.desc: Hayley Udall tries to make ends meet for herself and her 14 year-old daughter while providing alimony for a horrible ex-husband. She wishes her problems with her ex could go away, and upon venting her frustrations one night, finds herself tangled up in a pact with two people (Melanie and Kevin) to “eliminate” each other's problems.

programme.title: A Friend's Obsession
programme.desc: After Megan's fiancé is killed, Lloyd follows her to win her love, but her new boyfriend stands in the way.

programme.title: Fools Rush In (1997)
programme.desc: Sparks fly and cultures collide in this romantic comedy about a casual night of passion that turns into the love of a lifetime. Matthew Perry and Salma Hayek star.

programme.title: Sleepless In Seattle
programme.desc: On her way to her engagement, Annie Reed hears a young boy on the radio wishing that his father would find a new wife. Unable to forget the story of Sam and his son, something begins to happen to Annie, something she's not really aware of, something like...magic.

programme.title: Here Comes The Boom
programme.desc: A biology teacher takes up fighting in mixed martial arts matches in order to raise money to save the music program at his school.

programme.title: The House Bunny
programme.desc: The story of a Playboy Bunny who teaches an awkward sorority about the opposite sex - only to learn that what boys really like is what's on the inside.

programme.title: Flow
programme.desc: Sam, 76, a retired poet, is thrown out of his own home by his daughter. His son Bo leaves him at an assisted living facility where old age takes over. Bored out of his mind he approaches another resident Carl and asks him to record a rap song.

programme.title: India Sweets and Spices
programme.desc: When Alia returns home from university, she challenges her parents' elitist lifestyle expensive jewellery, lavish dinner parties, and gossiping aunties. But when she invites the son of a local shopkeeper to her mother's upcoming soiree, family secrets begin to surface.

programme.title: Poms
programme.desc: POMS is an uplifting comedy about Martha a woman who moves into a retirement community and starts a cheerleading squad with her fellow residents, Sheryl, Olive and Alice, proving that it's never too late to follow your dreams.

programme.title: Dear Elizabeth
programme.desc: A man who leads a dull life accidentally stalks an old college classmate, actress Elizabeth Banks, on social media. He rediscovers more of himself and the true meaning of friendship in his attempts to prove he knows her.

programme.title: The White, the Yellow, and the Black
programme.desc: In the 19th century, when the Japanese Emperor sends a gift pony to the US President it gets stolen and ransomed by Indians but Sheriff Gideon aided by an inept Japanese servant offers to deliver the ransom.

programme.title: Alive or Preferably Dead
programme.desc: Two brothers, Monty and Ted, will inherit $300,000 if they manage to live together for six months.

programme.title: The Glory Guys
programme.desc: What could be worse for two cavalry officers than to battle with native tribes? To battle each other for the same woman.

programme.title: The Red Pony
programme.desc: A ranch boy is gifted with a colt, grows to love him but the colt escapes, with tragic results.

programme.title: Ninja: Shadow Of A Tear
programme.desc: Scott Adkins returns as Casey Bowman, who is now the sensei of a successful dojo, married to the beautiful Namiko, and expecting their first baby. But when Casey returns home one day to find someone has brutally killed Namiko, bereft, Casey has only one thing left to live for... Revenge.

programme.title: Miracles: The Canton Godfather
programme.desc: A country boy becomes the head of a gang through the purchase of some lucky roses from an old lady. He and a singer at the gang's nightclub try to do a good deed for the old lady when her daughter comes to visit.

programme.title: Exit Speed
programme.desc: Strangers use improvised weapons, adrenaline and sheer guts to mount a defense against murderous bikers and their survival depends on doing the unthinkable - fighting for their lives!

programme.title: Deadly Inferno
programme.desc: During some extensive renovations on an eight-storey office building, a major gas leak leads to a terrible explosion, trapping the injured staff in a fiery maze. Can the brave firefighters provide a safe exit from this deadly inferno?

programme.title: Smoking Gun
programme.desc: Sydney and Nigel search for Al Capone's diamond-encrusted gun at the behest of a man hoping it will clear his grandfather of a murder he was framed for.

programme.title: Affaire de Coeur
programme.desc: Sydney and Nigel go to Scotland to find the second ring of the pair of Twining Rings of Calum and Elena.

programme.title: Thank You Very Much
programme.desc: Sydney and Nigel go to Germany to find a lost Elvis Presley guitar.

programme.desc: Sydney, Nigel and Derek Lloyd go to the Peruvian jungle to look for the Paracelsus scrolls which contain the formula for turning lead into gold.

programme.title: Flag Day
programme.desc: Sydney and Nigel head to Larivee, California to find the Pioneer's Bear Flag.

programme.title: Emperors Bride

programme.title: Diamond in the Rough

programme.title: Nine Lives
programme.desc: Everyone who steals a statue that represents the Egyptian cat-goddess Mafdet is killed. Now, the statue has disappeared and Sidney and Nigel are tasked with retrieving it.

programme.title: Kenny Barron
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron's June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine's Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet). Their seamless blend of classic bebop and modern explorations spoke of a deep, emotive connection to each note, captivating the Ukrainian audience with lyrical improvisations during this unforgettable concert.

programme.title: Jaco Pastorius
programme.desc: The audience at the Montreal Jazz Festival in Canada was in for a treat on July 3, 1982, as a true musical innovator hit the stage: Jaco Pastorius, who transformed the electric bass into a formidable solo instrument. Combining intricate harmonics, fluid melodies, and unparalleled technical skill, Pastorius left a lasting impact on the music world. In this concert, he is accompanied by Peter Erskine (drums), Don Alias (percussion), Othello Molineaux (steel drums), Bob Mintzer (tenor sax and bass clarinet), and Randy Brecker (trumpet and electronics). They perform “Chicken”, “Donna Lee”, “Mr. Phone Bone”, and “Fannie Mae”. Don't miss this extraordinary opportunity to experience Jaco Pastorius's electrifying performance at the Montreal Jazz Festival 1982!

programme.title: Carla Bley, Steve Swallow, Wayne Krantz & Victor Lewis
programme.sub-title: Carla Bley Sextet live at Estival Lugano 1986
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. Discover the special bond between pianist Carla Bley and bassist Steve Swallow. The two have performed in the same bands since the '60s and have been romantic partners for more than two decades. Watching them perform is the definition of musical telepathy. Together with musicians Wayne Krantz, Victor Lewis, Larry Willis, and Don Alias, they form an amazing sextet at Estival in 1986.

programme.title: Wilton Felder, Joe Sample, Reichii Guillory & Eddie Davis
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. The Crusaders, an American jazz fusion group that was popular in the '70s employed a two-manned front-line horn section. The group's sound was rooted in hard bop, with an emphasis on R&B and soul. Their performance at Estival is beyond soulful and an amazing show to watch.

programme.title: Dizzy Gillespie, Tony Coe, Derek Humble & Billy Mitchell
programme.desc: American jazz trumpeter, composer, and bandleader Dizzy Gillespie (1917-1993) was one of the seminal figures of the bebop movement. He fuses all musical forms rooted in African culture, such as music from Cuba, Latin America and the Caribbean, into his music. On November 4, 1970 he played a concert in Denmark with the Kenny Clarke/Francy Boland Big Band, performing Con Alma, Brother K, Now Hear My Meanin', Manteca, Let Me Outta Here, and Things Are Here.

programme.title: Lionel Hampton
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Miriam Makeba, J.K. Naimro, Stanley Todd & Al Sanders
programme.sub-title: Miriam Makeba Live at Estival Lugano 1985
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. Miriam Makeba, also named Mama Africa, was a South African singer, actress, United Nations goodwill ambassador, and civil-rights activist. Her career flourished in the US, where she released several albums. Makeba was among the first African musicians to receive worldwide recognition. She brought African music to a Western audience, and popularized the world music and Afropop genres. Her performances at Estival Lugano is beyond incredible. Her voice, the power and the soul summarizes her musicality in 40 minutes, together with her band and extremely talented backing-vocals.

programme.title: Kenny Barron
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron's June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine's Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet). Their seamless blend of classic bebop and modern explorations spoke of a deep, emotive connection to each note, captivating the Ukrainian audience with lyrical improvisations during this unforgettable concert.

programme.title: Cannonball Adderley, Nat Adderley, Yusuf Lateef & Joe Zawinul
programme.desc: Cannonball Adderley: Live in '63 boasts two beautifully filmed concerts from one of the most celebrated sextets in jazz history, captured at the top of their game. Cannonball Adderley (alto sax), Nat Adderley (cornet), and the masterful Yusef Lateef (tenor sax, flute, oboe), provide a massive three-horn frontline attack, while the stellar rhythm section featuring a pre-Weather Report Joe Zawinul (piano), Sam Jones (bass), and Louis Hayes (drums) fuel the songs with a deep infectious swing. Quincy Jones' "Jessica's Day" leaps from the gate with a huge big band sound that is extraordinary for only six musicians. This recording is a reminder that Cannonball Adderley was one of the most outstanding and highly respected alto saxophonists in the history of jazz. He was a bluesy jazzman who could play anything in superb fashion.

programme.title: Rahsaan Roland Kirk
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: David Radzynski, Franz Welser-Möst & Cleveland Orchestra
programme.sub-title: Richard Strauss - A Hero's Life, Op. 40
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst leads the Cleveland Orchestra in a concert performing Richard Strauss' Ein Heldenleben, Op. 40. Violin soloist is David Radzynski. Recorded at Severance Hall in Cleveland in February 2023. Strauss, at the age of 34, sparked outrage when he cast himself as the central figure of his tone poem. Generally agreed to be autobiographical, the work contains more than thirty quotations from Strauss's earlier works.

programme.title: Renaud Capuçon, Gerard Causse, Iddo Bar-Shai & Jean-Jacques Kantorow
programme.sub-title: Chamber music by Mozart and Shostakovich
programme.desc: French violinist Renaud Capuçon appears at the festival Les Coups de Cœur de Chantilly, presenting a chamber music program consisting of classical and 20th century repertoire. He performs with the soloists of the International Menuhin Music Academy led by French conductor Jean-Jacques Kantorow. First on the program is Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Sinfonia Concertante in E-flat major, K. 364, in which Capuçon and violist Gérard Caussé appear as the soloists. Capuçon is then joined by pianist Iddo Bar-Shaï for a performance of Mozart's Sonata for violin and piano in E minor, K. 304. The program closes with Dmitri Shostakovich's Chamber Symphony in C minor, Op. 110a, which is a transcription of Shostakovich's String Quartet No. 8 by Russian conductor Rudolf Barshai, the composer's close friend. This performance was recorded at Château de Chantilly, on May 15, 2021.

programme.title: Silvia Chiesa & Maurizio Baglini
programme.desc: Italian cellist Silvia Chiesa and Italian pianist Maurizio Baglini perform a wonderful recital of works by Ferruccio Busoni, Franz Liszt, Frédéric Chopin, and Sergei Rachmaninoff. On the program are Busoni's Kultaselle – 10 variations on a Finnish folksong Liszt's Two Elegies for cello and piano Chopin's Introduction and Polonaise brillante in C major, Op. 3 and Rachmaninoff's Sonata in G minor for cello and piano, Op. 19. As an encore, the duo plays Leonard Bernstein's iconic composition ‘Tonight' from the musical West Side Story. This performance was recorded at Sala Verdi of the Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi in Milan, Italy, on November 4, 2024.

programme.title: Soloists of the Lucerne Festival Orchestra
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Barbara Hannigan & Cleveland Orchestra
programme.desc: Barbara Hannigan, soprano and conductor, won the Grammy for “Best Classical Solo Vocal Album CRAZY GIRL CRAZY (Gershwin, Berg and Berio) 2018 and took home the Grammy for “Artist of the Year” in 2022. In autumn 2023 she made her long-awaited conducting debut with the Cleveland Orchestra. The programme featured an interesting mix of old and new with Haydn´s Symphony No. 44 in E-minor, Vivier´s Lonely Child', Ligeti´s 'Lontano' and Death and Transfiguration by Richard Strauss.

programme.title: Foreigner
programme.desc: Featuring the classic Foreigner line-up of Jones, Gramm, McDonald, Greenwood, Gagliardi and Elliott, this show captures the essence of a group who would go on to become one of the best-selling bands of all time. On April 27 1978, after their self-titled debut album had spent a year in the US Top 20, rock's conquering heroes played a sold-out show at London's legendary music venue, the Rainbow Theatre. Opening with 'Long, Long Way From Home', the band's legion of fans were treated to a magnificent display of musicianship and performance, including local hit singles, 'Feels Like The First Time' and 'Cold As Ice', as well as an exclusive preview of two tracks from the upcoming ‘Double Vision' album. Forty years on, this definitive performance by the original band has been restored from the original film reels, remixed and remastered for this release.

programme.title: John Mellencamp
programme.desc: John Mellencamp's career in music, spanning more than 42 years, has seen him transition from pop star to one of the most highly regarded songwriters of a generation. Filmed at the landmark Chicago Theatre, just 250 miles away from his upbringing in Indiana, this cinematic concert documentary film captures John Mellencamp reflecting on his career accompanied by self-narration from his highly personal audio diary on his Midwestern upbringing, career and outlook on life as a whole. Meant to be more than just your run of the mill concert film, this intimate performance with full band will fully envelop the viewer into the Mellencamp mindset. “My vision was true, and my heart was too. And there was no end to what I could dream. Life is short, even in its longest days.”

programme.title: Lady Gaga
programme.desc: Lady Gaga's performance at the iTunes Festival in London on September 1, 2013 marks the superstar's first full concert since the The Born This Way Ball. It is an eight song set containing the world premiere of seven tracks from her fourth album, ARTPOP: "Aura" "MANiCURE" "Artpop" "Jewels N' Drugs" ft. T.I., Too $hort and Twista "Sexxx Dreams", "Swine" and "I Wanna Be With You", a song that transformed into "Dope" for ARTPOP. During the concert, captured stunningly in HD, Gaga says that she's "a bit like Dorothy right now." The stage is her Kansas, the crowd is her family, and their reunion is pure magic. Lady Gaga, her dancers, and her band traverse through visual and musical themes of love, sex, violence, beauty, danger, empowerment, hustle, lust, and above all ART. Throughout, Gaga lays her heart bare for the audience and the cameras with every note sung and every word spoken.

programme.title: San Andreas Mega Seísmo
programme.desc: Los científicos hacen un horrible descubrimiento: El "Big One" se acerca en dos días, con él, California se hundirá en el océano. Su única esperanza es romper un volcán que desplace la energía del terremoto y construya una nueva corteza en la superficie. programme.title: Los Piratas
programme.desc: Dios Ama el Caviar es la fascinante historia de IOANNIS VARVAKIS y su viaje desde humilde pirata griego hasta convertirse en millonario internacional del caviar, con la confianza de Catalina la Grande de Rusia. Sin embargo, su riqueza y poder no le otorgan satisfacción, y su ambición desmedida solo le trae sufrimiento, hasta que lo entrega todo, incluso a sí mismo, en nombre del amor. Esta epopeya, basada en la vida real de Varvakis, se desarrolla desde la isla griega de Psara hasta la corte de Catalina la Grande en Rusia y las orillas del mar Caspio, para luego regresar a Grecia, un país desgarrado por la guerra civil y la lucha por la independencia durante la Revolución de 1821 contra el Imperio Otomano.

programme.desc: Finalizada la Guerra de Secesión, un hombre negro, vestido con el uniforme del ejército unionista, vuelve al rancho de su anterior amo, quien lo hace copropietario de sus tierras. Este hecho provoca la reacción de algunos vecinos racistas y fanáticos, cuyas ideas radicales acerca de la esclavitud y la diferencia de clases fundadas en el color de la piel, siguen muy arraigadas.

programme.title: La máscara de cera
programme.desc: París, año 1900. Una pareja es brutalmente asesinada por un hombre enmascarado frente a su hija. Años más tarde, la joven empieza a trabajar en un museo de cera de Roma que recrea escenas de crímenes.

programme.title: El último bailarín de Mao
programme.desc: Basada en una historia real, la película cuenta la vida de Li Cunxin, rescatado a los once años de un pequeño pueblo de China por delegados culturales y enviado a Pekín. Allí comienza un increíble viaje vital que le llevará a pasar años de entrenamiento brutal para convertirse en uno de los mejores bailarines del mundo, aclamado como un héroe de la China comunista y, más tarde, despreciado por traidor.

programme.title: Pride
programme.desc: Verano de 1984. Thatcher gobierna y el Sindicato Nacional de Mineros (NUM) ha convocado una huelga. Durante la manifestación del Orgullo Gay en Londres, un grupo de lesbianas y gays se dedica a recaudar fondos para ayudar a las familias de los mineros.

programme.title: Viaje a Italia
programme.desc: Steve Coogan y Rob Brydon reciben el encargo de un nuevo viaje gastronómico, esta vez por Italia. Estos dos improbables amigos conducen por todo el país mientras vuelven a discutir sobre la vida, el amor y el cine.

programme.title: El hombre del brazo de oro
programme.desc: Frankie Machine, un hombre con talento musical sale de la cárcel y, además, consigue dejar la heroína. Su principal problema será encontrar un medio de vida honrado y evitar las drogas y el juego.

programme.title: Prisioneros del sol
programme.desc: Una expedición multinacional descubre una ciudad perdida bajo una pirámide en la que tendrán que detener a los dioses del antiguo Egipto que han despertado para iniciar el apocalipsis.

programme.title: Hometown Remedy
programme.desc: Un cirujano vuelve a casa y descubre un romance con el médico compasivo del pueblo.

programme.title: Yo Quiero a Eva
programme.desc: Eva es invitada a festejar el cumpleaños de su vecino, sin sospechar que es una cita romántica.

programme.title: Amor a Primera Visa
programme.desc: Tras su fiesta de despedida, despierta en el apartamento de un apuesto mariachi y padre soltero.

programme.title: Lucy en el infierno
programme.desc: Un empresario se encuentra con Olga en una cita a ciegas sin saber que pronto será sujeto de un experimento.

programme.title: Un Amor Hasta Las Patas
programme.desc: Mayra es una chica tímida e insegura. Su amiga le busca una cita a través de las redes que resulta terrible.

programme.title: Zona de caza
programme.desc: Una madre huye de su marido mafioso y de sus peligrosos sicarios que intentan darle caza. Desesperada por encontrar un escondite para ella y sus hijos, se refugia en la cabaña del bosque de un excursionista llamado Jake.

programme.title: St. Vincent
programme.desc: Con 2 nominaciones a los Globos de Oro y con un trío cómico protagonista impecable, 'St. Vincent' cuenta la historia de un chico cuyos padres se acaban de divorciar. La situación no es sencilla para él, le cuesta aceptar la nueva realidad. Sin embargo, las cosas cambian cuando conoce a su vecino.

programme.title: El escritor
programme.desc: Oso de Plata al Mejor Director en el Festival de Berlín 2010. Roman Polanski dirige un apasionado thriller político cargado de suspense en un mundo en el que nada es lo que parece.

programme.title: Siempre a tu lado. Hachiko
programme.desc: Basada en hechos reales, la película sigue la leal amistad entre un profesor y su perro Akita. Hachi espera en la estación, incluso cuando su dueño ya no regresa.

programme.title: Lost River
programme.desc: Hipnótico debut en la dirección del actor Ryan Gosling ('Drive'). En los decadentes suburbios de Detroit, Billy lucha por sacar adelante a sus 2 hijos y no perder su casa. Cuando su tiempo se agota, Billy decide aceptar un nuevo trabajo que le ofrece su director en un misterioso y extraño lugar...

programme.title: El misterio de God's Pocket
programme.desc: Cuando su alocado hijastro, Leon, muere en un "accidente" laboral, Mickey intenta olvidar esa fatalidad buscando enterrar el cuerpo lo más rápidamente posible.

programme.title: Una historia real
programme.desc: Cuando el desafortunado reportero del NY Times, Michael Finkel (Jonah Hill) conoce a Christian Longo (James Franco) –el cual ha robado su identidad– su investigación se convierte en una tensa persecución entre ratón y gato.

programme.title: El gran partido
programme.desc: Los nazis organizan un partido de fútbol entre un equipo de reclusos del campo y un equipo nazi de élite en el cumpleaños de Adolf Hitler.

programme.title: Tucker: The Man and His Dream
programme.desc: Un diseñador de coches se enfrenta a toda la industria automovilística con sus revolucionarios diseños.

programme.title: El Principe Enamorado
programme.desc: El Príncipe Carlos llega a la Costa Brava con la intención de pasar unas semanas de descanso.

programme.title: Encontrando el Fin del Mundo
programme.desc: Tras la muerte de su esposa y su hijo menor, Jorge, un músico desempleado, queda a cargo de su hijo mayor.

programme.title: La Marca Del Lobo
programme.desc: Una muchacha presenció el asesinato de su familia. La joven sobrevivió adentrándose en el bosque.

programme.title: Love's Kitchen
programme.desc: Bob, un exitoso chef, rehace su vida en un restaurante rural. Allí volverá a creer en el amor.

programme.title: El Chico De La Burbuja De Plástico
programme.desc: Un niño que nace con una deficiencia en su sistema inmunológico

programme.title: Amar
programme.desc: Una de las óperas primas más estimulantes y reveladoras del año. El talento de Esteban Crespo, nominado al Oscar por el cortometraje "Aquel no era yo" se confirma con esta película de amores tan intensos que se viven como si cada día fuera el último.

programme.title: Un invierno en la playa
programme.desc: Tres años después de su divorcio, el novelista Bill Borgens no puede dejar de pensar en su exmujer, Erica, que lo abandonó por otro hombre. Pero a pesar de los esfuerzos de su vecina con derecho a roce, Tricia, para que vuelva a estar «en el mercado», él no tiene ojos para nadie más.

programme.title: El velo pintado
programme.desc: Walter y Kitty son una pareja de ingleses que deciden casarse por motivos equivocados y se establecen en Shanghai. En esta exótica ciudad, ella se enamora de otro hombre.

programme.title: El Vestido De Compromiso
programme.desc: Cuando Claudia consigue llevar el afortunado vestido de dama de honor que ha hecho que todas sus amigas se casen, se da cuenta de que ha estado buscando el amor en los lugares equivocados.

programme.title: Salvar o morir
programme.desc: Franck es un bombero de París. Le gusta salvar a la gente. Vive en el parque de bomberos con su esposa, que da a luz a gemelos. No puede ser más feliz. Durante una intervención en un incendio, se sacrifica para salvar a sus hombres. Cuando se despierta en un hospital se da cuenta que tendrá que volver a aprender a vivir y, a su vez, aceptar ser salvado.

programme.title: Salyut-7, héroes en el espacio
programme.desc: 1985. La estación soviética no tripulada Salyut-7, en órbita alrededor de la Tierra, es un orgullo para la industria espacial de la URSS. De repente, se pierde la comunicación con el centro de control. La posible caída de la estación puede acabar en una catástrofe en la que pierdan la vida muchas personas. Dos astronautas son enviados para descubrir qué ha ocurrido, en una arriesgada misión sin precedentes en la historia de la navegación espacial.

programme.title: Los limoneros
programme.desc: Salma, una viuda palestina, tiene un litigio con el ministro de Defensa israelí. La casa de éste, en la frontera palestino-isra…

programme.title: Fuga explosiva
programme.desc: Un expiloto de coches especializado en fugas de bancos evade el programa de protección de testigos con el fin de llevar a su novia a Los Ángeles para que pueda hacerse con el trabajo de su vida. Sin embargo, tanto las autoridades policiales como los integrantes de su antigua banda se enterarán de su reaparición y dará comienzo una persecución sin freno.

programme.title: El mundo resplandeciente
programme.desc: En el mismo instante que la pequeña Margaret descubre la naturaleza violenta de la relación de sus padres, su hermana gemela muere ahogada en una piscina.

programme.title: Nowhere
programme.desc: En un país latinoamericano, su dictador ha urdido un siniestro plan.

programme.title: Todo Me Pasa A Mí
programme.desc: El regreso de un amigo de la India hace que un grupo de jóvenes se cuestione sus relaciones.

programme.title: Buffaloed
programme.desc: Joven entra en el mundo de la cobranza de deudas.

programme.title: Rivales
programme.desc: Dos equipos juveniles van a la final en Sevilla mientras se entrelazan historias familiares y sociales.

programme.title: Si fuéramos los últimos
programme.desc: A la deriva en su averiado transbordador espacial y con pocas esperanzas de ser rescatados, dos astronautas discuten si es mejor pasar los días que les quedan como amigos o algo más. El roce hace el cariño y las chispas cada vez van más en aumento…

programme.title: Begin Again
programme.desc: Éxito independiente del 2014 nominado al Oscar® a Mejor canción. Fresca historia llena de optimismo y buen rollo sobre el amor y la música como bálsamos de la felicidad.

programme.title: Atraco por duplicado
programme.desc: Tripp Kennedy entra tranquilamente en una sucursal bancaria poco antes de la hora de cierre, justo en el momento en que dos bandas distintas convergen por casualidad con intención de realizar un atraco. Todos ellos quedan atrapados en el edificio durante una noche que promete acción y diversión...

programme.title: Fingiendo ser punk
programme.desc: En 1979, Angus, con el apoyo de su padre, descubre la escena musical underground post-punk de Christchurch, Nueva Zelanda, y supera sus dudas, las burlas y una tragedia familiar para subirse al escenario.

programme.title: Seducción a la carta
programme.desc: La magia y la risa son los ingredientes principales de esta historia de amor sobre una propietaria y chef de un restaurante y un jefe de departamento de una tienda que no parecen tener nada en común.

programme.title: Tess Y Su Guardaespaldas
programme.desc: Narra la relación entre Tess Carlisle (MacLaine), una testaruda e incontrolable viuda, antigua primera dama de los Estados Unidos, y Doug Hugh (Nicolas Cage), jefe del servicio de seguridad cuyo trabajo consiste en vigilarla. Doug, cansado de las excentricidades, los caprichos y el complejo carácter de la dama, ha pedido encarecidamente que lo cambien de destino, pero Tess se las ingenia para que se quede con ella de forma permanente...

programme.title: El Tesoro De Curly
programme.desc: En esta secuela del gran éxito de taquilla, el neoyorquino Mitch Robbins (Billy Crystal) y su hermano Glen (Jon Lovitz), la oveja negra de la familia, encuentran por accidente un antiguo mapa del tesoro oculto en la cinta del sombrero del difunto Curly. Después de visitar la biblioteca local, descubren que el padre de Curly participó en un célebre robo a un tren.

programme.title: Escuela De Genios
programme.desc: Tres brillantes universitarios trabajan en un proyecto de laboratorio pero tienen tiempo para divertirse y convertir la residencia en una pista de patinaje sobre hielo, desmontar y montar el coche de un compañero u organizar una fiesta playera en pleno auditórium. Cuando el trío descubre que el profesor Hathaway les ha tenido trabajando en un arma secreta para el ejército, deciden tramar un plan de venganza que dejará boquiabiertos a los militares.

programme.title: Mis Otros Yo
programme.desc: Doug Kinney es un buen padre, esposo y hombre de negocios pero sin mucho tiempo para dedicar a su familia ni a su trabajo. El experto en genética Owen Leeds le brinda la oportunidad de tomar las riendas de su vida gracias a la clonación. Si la vida ya era complicada con un solo Doug, aún lo será más con múltiples clones. Una divertida comedia que aborda la posibilidad científica de la clonación y el desastre que puede generar.

programme.title: Sitting Bull: Casta de guerreros
programme.desc: Sitting Bull, líder de los Sioux, se ve obligado por el general Custer a reaccionar violentamente, lo que lleva a la famosa batalla en Little Bighorn. Parrish, un amigo de los Sioux, intenta evitar la sangre derramada pero es acusado de colaborar con el enemigo. Sitting Bull intercede ante el presidente Grant para salvarlo.

programme.title: El imperio del ganado
programme.desc: Liberado de la cárcel, un jefe de ganado es solicitado por los barones rivales para conducir sus respectivos rebaños de ganado a Fort Clemson.

programme.title: 30 Winchester para El Diablo
programme.desc: El líder de los bandidos El Diablo, que controla el país con su banda, planea conseguir oro destinado a México, pero no es el único.

programme.title: Relevo para un pistolero
programme.desc: Un desconocido de Boston ofrece a un notorio ex forajido de Arizona un trabajo que no puede rechazar.

programme.title: La cárcel de Cananea
programme.desc: En este western mexicano, un agente de la ley sigue el rastro de un joven criminal. Con Pedro Armendáriz en el papel protagonista, la persecución se desarrolla en un entorno marcado por el peligro, la justicia y los conflictos propios del Viejo Oeste.

programme.title: Resistencia
programme.desc: En 1944, un grupo de mujeres en un aislado pueblo galés descubre que sus maridos han desparecido misteriosamente.

programme.title: Weight
programme.desc: La banda de Dub, liderada por Rob, Turk y Junkyard, controla la droga en la zona oeste. Cuando Charlotte asume el mando, los hombres dudan de ella. Pero su determinación y estrategia pronto dejan claro por qué Dub la eligió como sucesora.

programme.title: Reus
programme.desc: Crónica de la lucha entre dos familias por el control del barrio Reus, en Montevideo.

programme.title: Giros
programme.desc: Karla debe decidir entre emigrar con su familia o quedarse en Cuba y seguir su propio rumbo. Entre amistades, amores y dudas, enfrenta los giros del destino y encuentra el valor de elegir por sí misma. Una historia de identidad, libertad y coraje frente a decisiones que marcan la vida.

programme.title: Fahrenheit 11/9
programme.desc: Fahrenheit 11/9 es una mirada polémica y cómica a los tiempos que corren en EE.UU. Michael Moore retrata las elecciones presidenciales de 2016 y estos dos primeros años del mandato de Donald Trump intentando responder las dos preguntas más importantes de la era Trump: “¿Cómo demonios hemos llegado hasta aquí?” y “¿Cómo demonios salimos?”.

programme.title: 3 generaciones
programme.desc: Regan (Elle Fanning) es una adolescente de Nueva York que decide operarse para cambiar de sexo. Junto a su madre, Maggie (Naomi Watts), viven en casa de su abuela, Dolly (Susan Sarandon), una manager de música que comparte piso con su novia. Maggie tiene que enfrentarse al padre de Regan para que firme también los permisos de la operación y deberá asumir que tiene que criar a su única hija como un hijo.

programme.title: The winter lake
programme.desc: Después de hacer un descubrimiento sombrío en un lago estacional, un adolescente retraído descubre la verdad sobre sus vecinos, un padre y una hija que albergan secretos siniestros.

programme.title: El club de los incomprendidos
programme.desc: A Valeria le ha cambiado la vida por completo. La separación de sus padres la ha llevado a trasladarse a Madrid con su madre. Eso supone muchas cosas nuevas. Casa, instituto, amigos…La cosa se complica todavía más cuando Valeria se ve obligada a asistir al grupo de terapia que organiza el psicólogo del instituto. Allí se encontrará con otros compañeros que también se ven obligados a ir pero lo que parece un mal comienzo paralajoven adolescente, no es más que el inicio de una increíble experiencia vital nuevos amigos, una ciudad llena de posibilidades, acariciar la madurez y sobre todo descubrir que el primer amor es bastante más complicado de lo que se dice en loscuentos de princesas.

programme.title: Ausentes
programme.desc: Julia y Samuel se mudan con los niños a una apartada urbanización en las afueras de la ciudad. Parece un lugar ideal, pero Julia pronto descubrirá que esconde algo extraño porque la urbanización está completamente desierta.

programme.title: Anabel
programme.desc: Tras la marcha, en circunstancias algo turbias, de Anabel, sus dos compañeras de piso deben buscar a alguien más con quien compartir el alquiler. El elegido es un señor mayor que logra ganarse su confianza, pero que pronto se descubrirá como una presencia extraña e inquietante.

programme.title: Frontera
programme.desc: Un grupo de teatro ensaya una versión de 12 hombres sin piedad cuando los interrumpe una alarma. Nos encontramos dentro de la prisión de Quatre Camins y la señal indica el aislamiento de los módulo.

programme.title: En temporada baja
programme.desc: Sigue la supuesta camaradería formada por Alberto, "el crack", quien fue un exitoso representante de futbolistas que ahora vive en un camping a las afueras de Valencia, y Charly, un policía divorciado que duerme en el trabajo.

programme.title: El sueño de Valentín
programme.desc: 1960, Buenos Aires. Valentín es un niño de nueve años que vive con su abuela. Su madre desapareció cuando él tenía tres años y su padre es un hombre descontrolado e incapaz de asumir responsabilidades. Valentín es un niño solitario que busca constantemente amor y cariño.

programme.title: Spider Baby
programme.desc: An inbred family is visited in their rural mansion by greedy distant relatives intent on taking the family home and inheritance.

programme.title: Cuadecuc Vampir
programme.desc: An analysis of the construction mechanism for the magic in dominant narrative cinema though the filming of Nachts, wenn Dracula erwacht (1970), a commercial film by Jesus Franco.

programme.title: Raw Meat
programme.desc: When a government official disappears in the London tunnels, after several reports of missing people in the same location, Scotland Yard start to take the matter seriously,

programme.title: Hollywood Man
programme.desc: Hollywood action film star Rafe Stoker has sunk $130,000 of his own money into his own production, but can't find legitimate financing to complete the film. His mob-connected investor demands an exorbitant amount of collateral and a guarantee that Rafe hand over a commercially acceptable film in 4 weeks, then hires a gang of psycho bikers to sabotage the picture.

programme.title: En tierras peligrosas
programme.desc: Un hombre que acaba de enviudar es sorprendido en su remota casa de campo por un policía que persigue a dos criminales. A éstos se les unirán el resto de la banda criminal y el socio del policía, en un enfrentamiento de bandos mortal.

programme.title: El hombre del presidente II
programme.desc: Joshua McCord, veterano de las fuerzas especiales y guardaespaldas del presidente de los Estados Unidos, recibe una importante misión confiada directamente por el presidente.

programme.title: La particula de Dios
programme.desc: El detective privado Ned Cruz recibe el encargo de encontrar a Lexi Persimmon, una stripper que ha desaparecido junto a un alijo de diamantes valorado en 30 millones de dólares. Cruz topará con personajes oscuros, algunos morirán misteriosamente, otros tienen entre manos planes siniestros.

programme.title: Pequeño gran guerrero
programme.desc: Un viejo soldado secuestra a un joven general de un estado enemigo y lo lleva en un largo viaje para conseguir la recompensa.

programme.title: Código de defensa
programme.desc: A un agente especial estadounidense caído en desgracia (John Cusack) se le encarga la rutinaria misión de proteger a una joven civil (Malin Akerman), cifradora de códigos de defensa, en una estación emisora secreta en Gran Bretaña.

programme.title: Juego Mortal
programme.desc: Nueve amigos despiertan con bombas en el pecho y descubren que pueden transferirse el tiempo entre ellos.

programme.title: Sin escapatoria
programme.desc: Shannon presencia un asesinato y huye de policías corruptos. Jack, un exagente, la ayuda a sobrevivir.

programme.title: Twist
programme.desc: Un joven grafitero se une a una banda para dar el golpe del siglo entre traiciones y persecuciones.

programme.title: Bigfoot
programme.desc: Bigfoot ataca un concierto de música.

programme.title: Asesinos Anónimos
programme.desc: En un grupo de apoyo para asesinos, la confianza es importante, pero un misterio creará fuertes tensiones.

programme.title: Driven
programme.desc: Un joven piloto exitoso está en medio de una temporada de campeonato y se está desmoronando. Llaman a un ex campeón de CART para que lo guíe.

programme.title: The Green Hornet
programme.desc: De noche, Britt Reid , heredero del gran imperio periodístico creado por su padre, se convierte en un héroe enmascarado que se propone combatir el crimen: es The Green Hornet. Su compañero de aventuras es Kato , un experto en artes marciales.

programme.title: Los Angeles De Charlie Al Limite
programme.desc: Las tres agentes están de vuelta Los ángeles están dispuestas a dar guerra para recuperar una información encriptada en dos anillos, que revela las identidades de todas las personas acogidas al programa de protección de testigos. Cuando éstos empiezan a morir, sólo las intrépidas chicas podrán detener al responsable, usando su experiencia en el camuflaje, espionaje y artes marciales. Además se las tendrán que ver con un ángel caído -Demi Moore-.

programme.title: El Arte De Robar
programme.desc: Crunch Calhoun, un acróbata motociclista de tercera, y ladrón de arte en sus ratos libres, se junta con su escurridizo hermano para robar uno de los libros más valiosos del mundo. Pero para Crunch no se tratará sólo del libro, sino al mismo tiempo tener la posibilidad de reescribir algunos capítulos de su propio pasado.
